outline.unique_angle: An explicit keep-vs-rewrite split: a fixed reusable 5-block FORMAT the educator hands AI every time, paired with a named list of the exact things she rewrites by hand (child's real words, policy-speak removal, over-claimed outcome links) — shown with one concrete AI-draft-vs-final before/after. Top-3 either sell a tool (StoryLoop), teach format without the AI workflow (learningstories.help), or are audio-only and light on a written method (Empowered Educator). None give a side-by-side draft showing exactly which lines a human must own.

internal_link_note: Confirmed-published slugs from git log (one ece-ai, one nurse-ai cross-niche on the 'check AI output before it counts' theme). content-writer should verify these slugs still resolve and prefer an ece-ai EYLF-outcomes or observations post if one exists in src/content by build time.
warnings: VOLUME IS NOT MEASURED: no free tool returned a figure for this term on 2026-06-04 (keywordvolumechecker + Ubersuggest free were gated/empty). All KD numbers are manual SERP-audit estimates, not tool exports — treat as directional only.

Do NOT target the head term 'EYLF learning stories' — its SERP is .gov-dominated (education.gov.au, acecqa.gov.au) and near-impossible for a new domain. The whole opening is the 'with AI' + 'keep format / rewrite voice' long-tail.

KD estimate per contract formula = top10_avg_DR/5 + exact_match_count*2. Long-tail top results are low-DR (12-14) product/blog pages with one DR-38 outlier; rough KD ~14-18. Below the KD-25 ceiling, safe for a new domain.

Empowered Educator top result returned 403 to direct fetch; its coverage is inferred from search snippets + sibling posts, not a same-day body fetch — re-verify before leaning on it as the sole structural reference.

YMYL/ECE: this is documentation guidance for children. Per CLAUDE.md rule 5, content-writer must add ECT credential byline, cite the official EYLF V2.0 / ACECQA guideline, frame as 'in my practice' not advice, and stress the privacy step (strip names/faces before AI).

AdSense: childcare-tool vendors (LoveHeart, StoryLoop, earlyedu.ai) are active affiliate/ad targets in this SERP — there is commercial intent overlap, so an honest 'I tried X' affiliate angle is viable but must stay disclosed.
